brief:
American rapper Macklemore renewed his support for the Palestinian people during a concert performance in France, Shehab Wire reported. He pledged to sustain his backing of the Palestinian cause and called for Palestinian freedom, reaffirming his commitment to the movement.

The artist's remarks came as part of remarks delivered to the audience at the event. Macklemore stated he would continue championing Palestinian rights and using his platform to advocate for the cause, echoing previous public statements of solidarity he has made with Palestinians.
